description: Plans de récolement du réseau d'assainissement des eaux usées de Mana (1994 -1995) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Sets of scanned maps of plans for the rehabilitation of the wastewater network of the municipality of Mana. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Plans for the rehabilitation of the Mana wastewater system (1994-1995)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include assainissement, eau usée, mana, 1995, guyane. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
